title: UAAP: Once a 5-foot-5 guard, bruising Palacielo keeps expanding arsenal for NU
summary: PJ Palacielo flaunted a different facet of his game with a career-best eight assists to steer National University back to the win column, but he said it’s actually a skill he was once familiar with…
